text: No, it wasn’t about you. I was telling them about that video from the Bundesliga this week. If I’d wanted to say something about you, I’d have just said it.

Sure, but come on, man. You told that story right as I walked by, and everyone laughed. It’s a bit of a coincidence, don’t you think? If you’ve got something to say about my miss on Sunday, just say it straight.
Honestly, I didn’t even think of your chance on Sunday. It was just a stupid viral clip, nothing to do with you. If I had a problem with your play, I wouldn’t hide behind some joke at the bar.

Alright, if you say so. Still, the timing was pretty perfect for a dig, even if you won’t admit it. Next time, just keep it about football, not dumb jokes when people are right there. It’d save us both some time.
You can believe what you want, but I’m not going to tiptoe around every story in case someone takes it the wrong way. If you’re that sensitive about Sunday, maybe talk it out with the coach, not me.
Yeah, I’m sure you’ll just keep running your mouth either way. Don’t worry, I’m not losing sleep over it. Just don’t act surprised if people think you’re being a dick when you pull stuff like that.
Think what you want. I’m not here to babysit grown men’s egos. If a stupid story gets under your skin, that’s your problem, not mine.
